M-DBG-ADAPT.Purpose: Present behavior lifecycle, values and configuration through public readable parameters.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: IBehaviorAdapter and DefaultAdapter with cached public property discovery.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Private algorithm state and behavior mutation are excluded.

Requirements.REQ-001: Every Behavior subtype uses the shared adapter, including current and future composite types.
Requirements.REQ-002: Expose public instance getters without index parameters, including State, IsUpdating and typed Value/Target. Never read private fields or infer completion from value equality.

Outputs.OUT-001: Named accessors for actual public parameters.
